name: DigiBi — Auto-Provisioning (client → Retell agent + number)
description: On Paystack payment success: create Retell agent + number, flip HubSpot contact to client, onboarding task, owner notification. Auth via credentials.

nodes.name: Paystack Payment Webhook
nodes.notes: Point your Paystack charge.success webhook (or the existing Paystack Webhook workflow) at this node PRODUCTION url.

nodes.name: Create Retell Agent

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ response_engine: { type: 'retell-llm', llm_id: 'REPLACE_ME_RETELL_LLM_ID' }, voice_id: 'REPLACE_ME_VOICE_ID', agent_name: 'DigiBi Receptionist — ' + ($('Normalize Payment').item.json.first_name || $('Normalize Payment').item.json.email) }) }}

nodes.notes: CONFIRM Retell create-agent endpoint + body against your account. Uses the Retell API credential (Bearer). Set REPLACE_ME_RETELL_LLM_ID / _VOICE_ID in the body.

nodes.name: Provision Phone Number

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ inbound_agent_id: $('Create Retell Agent').item.json.agent_id, outbound_agent_id: $('Create Retell Agent').item.json.agent_id, nickname: 'DigiBi — ' + $('Normalize Payment').item.json.email }) }}

nodes.notes: CONFIRM: create-phone-number buys US/CA only; for a SA number use import-phone-number (BYOC). Uses the Retell API credential.

nodes.name: Flip HubSpot Contact to Client

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ properties: { digibi_lead_status: 'client', digibi_go_live_date: $('Normalize Payment').item.json.go_live_date, digibi_plan: $('Normalize Payment').item.json.plan, digibi_retell_agent_id: ($('Create Retell Agent').item.json.agent_id || ''), digibi_retell_number: ($('Provision Phone Number').item.json.phone_number || '') } }) }}

nodes.notes: Uses the HubSpot Private App credential. May need new properties: digibi_retell_agent_id, digibi_retell_number, digibi_go_live_date, digibi_plan.

nodes.name: Create Onboarding Checklist Task

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ properties: { hs_task_subject: 'Go-live checklist — ' + $('Normalize Payment').item.json.email, hs_task_body: 'New client provisioned. Finish: 1) Confirm/port their number to the Retell agent  2) Capture hours, services, pricing  3) Load FAQs + escalation rules  4) Test call + go live.  Plan: ' + $('Normalize Payment').item.json.plan + '  |  Retell agent: ' + ($('Create Retell Agent').item.json.agent_id || 'CHECK') + '  |  Number: ' + ($('Provision Phone Number').item.json.phone_number || 'CHECK'), hs_task_status: 'NOT_STARTED', hs_task_priority: 'HIGH', hs_timestamp: Date.now() } }) }}

nodes.notes: Creates a HubSpot task = go-live checklist. Uses the HubSpot Private App credential.

nodes.name: Notify Owner

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: ':tada: New DigiBi client provisioned: ' + $('Normalize Payment').item.json.email + ' (plan: ' + $('Normalize Payment').item.json.plan + '). Retell agent ' + ($('Create Retell Agent').item.json.agent_id || 'CHECK') + ', number ' + ($('Provision Phone Number').item.json.phone_number || 'CHECK') + '. Onboarding task created in HubSpot.' }) }}

nodes.notes: Slack ping to you. Set REPLACE_ME_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, or replace with an Email Send node.
